amendment_scope: Resource-only amendment: batch_size 8 to 4 after a hard-cap abort and before any score record was opened or interpreted.
title: Physical dynamic-response bridge for expressed choice under contextual intervention

model_contract.weights_precision: float16 on CUDA for the registered remote run
model_contract.scoring: deterministic next-token log probabilities for single-token A and B
model_contract.chat_template_mode: add_generation_prompt=true, enable_thinking=false; the template closes an empty thinking block before the answer token
model_contract.answer_boundary_check: For every rendered prompt, encoding prompt+A or prompt+B must preserve the prompt-token prefix and append exactly token 32 or 33.
model_contract.measured_object: expressed forced-choice state induced by the complete token history

arms.fresh_reset: byte-identical baseline in a fresh no-cache forward pass
arms.balanced_washout: balanced arguments followed by the washout instruction
arms.label: content-free unverified recommendation label for one option
arms.content: one substantive advocacy message for one option
arms.content_washout: substantive advocacy followed by the washout instruction
arms.repeated_content: the same substantive advocacy repeated without new evidence

canonical_score.meaning: Positive z favors canonical option 0. Display reversal is canonicalized before averaging.

two_stage_freeze.construction: Protocol, scenarios, runner, sources, environment, model hashes, and construction split are sealed before construction outcomes.
two_stage_freeze.calibration: epsilon_measurement and epsilon_restore are deterministic maxima from the construction split; no quantile or threshold is selected after reading confirmation.
two_stage_freeze.confirmation: A second registration binds the construction record hash, calibration hash, numeric thresholds, transition map, and untouched confirmation split before any confirmation inference.

calibration_rules.numeric_guard_ascii: 16 * 2^-23 * max(1, maximum absolute stored option log probability)
calibration_rules.epsilon_measurement_ascii: max(numeric_guard, every construction baseline/balanced order half-range, every construction baseline/fresh-reset difference)
calibration_rules.epsilon_restore_ascii: max(epsilon_measurement, every absolute construction balanced_washout-minus-balanced effect)

instrument_gates.R0_reset: Maximum baseline/fresh-reset difference must not exceed numeric_guard.
instrument_gates.O0_order: At least 8 of 10 split scenarios must have a baseline sign whose full two-order interval lies outside plus/minus epsilon_measurement.
instrument_gates.H0_hashes: Every registered protocol, scenario, source, model, tokenizer, construction, and calibration hash must match before its phase runs.

context_effect.pass: Median specificity exceeds epsilon_measurement and the exact one-sided sign-test p-value is at most 0.05 across the 20 scenario-by-target cells.

terminal_response.pooled_pass: none; the three-state distribution is reported

created_consensus.eligible: The baseline interval is stably opposite the advocated target.
created_consensus.event: Both display-order scores after repeated advocacy stably favor the target.
created_consensus.status: descriptive only; exact numerator and denominator reported

latent_transducer.state_rule: The complete two-order interval must lie below -epsilon_measurement, overlap the band, or lie above +epsilon_measurement.
latent_transducer.construction: Each observed (state,message_type) key must have exactly one target state.
latent_transducer.confirmation: Every held-out transition key must be present and reproduce its construction target exactly.
latent_transducer.separation_rule: A transducer failure does not erase descriptive context or terminal-response measurements and a context effect does not imply a valid transducer.

stop_rules: A hash, tokenizer, model, reset, or order precondition failure stops claim-eligible interpretation for that phase.
A construction transition conflict prevents any latent-state confirmation claim.
An unseen or mismatched confirmation transition yields latent_state_model_not_established.
No threshold, scenario, arm, family, or message may be changed after its applicable registration.

resource_contract.execution_target: remote CUDA pod; local laptop GPU is excluded while shared with deadline work or thermally elevated

claim_boundary: The experiment can characterize deterministic forced-choice context effects, washout behavior, strict created-consensus events, and held-out replay of one coarse response transducer in one Qwen0.8B instruction model. It cannot establish persistent weight change, moral truth, human preferences, a general value state, evaluator-channel recursive improvement, or a resolution of ASMP-9.
